reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses dislocation-controlled deformation in a different alloy system and elemental effects on mechanical properties in refractory HEAs, respectively. Neither passage provides any support for the key premises regarding magnetocaloric response, interfacial strain effects on magnetic transitions, or annealing effects in FeMnNiGeSi nanoscale films.
premises: Nanoscale FeMnNiGeSi films have high grain boundary density and significant residual interfacial strain/disorder
Interfacial strain/disorder broadens the distribution of magnetic exchange interactions and local transition temperatures
Broadened transition distribution suppresses peak magnetic entropy change and enhances hysteresis
